paragraphs: Caslano is among the newer pockets of Steiner Ranch, with homes generally priced in the $600K to $900K range. It is a small section, not gated, and falls under the Steiner Ranch Master Association. Being near the village retail area means errands are a short drive, and it also means the section sits close to the busier part of the community. Newer builds usually mean clean lines, large windows, and smaller yards with young trees and fresh landscaping, rather than the thick shade older sections have.
The glass is newer too, which makes it worth protecting from the start.

New construction leaves a particular film behind: stucco dust, paint overspray, sealant, and fine grit that stick to the glass long after move in. Newer sprinkler systems are also aggressive, and they spray the lower windows daily, which builds up hard water spots quickly. On newer glass, catching those early matters, because spots that sit for seasons can etch. Young trees mean less leaf litter than in the older sections, but pollen still arrives in winter and spring. Dust from nearby building work can blow in as well.
Fresh glass is easiest to restore, so a first clean now saves effort later.

We handle newer glass carefully. Before scraping anything, we check for stickers, paint specks and sealant, and use the right tools so we do not scratch. Exterior windows are cleaned with a dual RO, four stage pure water system with a DI resin tank, and poles reach up to three stories from the ground. Interior glass is cleaned by hand. Access is simple, with no gate and normal driveways. We usually schedule Caslano alongside Palisades and other newer sections, and visits usually land within two weeks. After the first clean, a repeat plan keeps the glass from building up film.
A 2,500 sq ft home comes to about $250 for exterior windows at $0.10 per sq ft. Expect about two to two and a half hours outside and around an hour and fifteen minutes inside.

faq.q: Can you clean construction dust off new windows?
faq.a: Yes. Dust, stucco residue and light overspray come off with pure water and careful tools. If we find sealant or paint specks, we remove them with the right edge so the glass is not scratched.

faq.q: Why do my new windows already have white spots?
faq.a: New sprinkler systems often hit the lower windows daily, and the minerals in that water dry on the glass. Early cleaning matters. Spots left for seasons can etch, and hard water spot removal is $10 per pane.

faq.q: Do I need to be home?
faq.a: Not for exterior windows if gates are unlocked and pets are inside. For interior cleaning, someone needs to let us in. We text when we are on the way.
